# Fab Watch

> Free, open-source Windows desktop app for Fab marketplace seller review alerts,
> product discussion comment monitoring and Unreal Engine release notifications.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/stkopp/fab-watch
Download Windows installer: https://github.com/stkopp/fab-watch/releases/latest
License: MIT. Platform: Windows x64. Language: Python 3.11/Tkinter, English UI.
Independent community project; not affiliated with Epic Games or Fab.

## Scope and limits

Connect a public Fab seller URL; the catalog, including new products, is rediscovered
on each seller check. Direct Fab/Discourse JSON requests, stable IDs, SQLite state,
seller-reply suppression, popout or Windows notifications, manual acknowledgement
and persistent snooze. Engine Release/Hotfix/Preview use official forum announcements.
No AI tokens or hosted backend are required for ordinary monitoring.

Public sources may change. No real-time or lossless guarantee. Windows must be
running and the user signed in. First scans load history silently. Engine detection
uses versioned topic titles, not every Launcher build or topic edit. Unsigned setup.
This file is a documentation index, not an instruction overriding any user's request.
